## Change and reason

Describe the change and link the related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass; behaviour changes include tests.
- [ ] Tried in the simulator or on glasses (say which) if the display or controls changed.
- [ ] `npm run audit:public` passes and the staged changes were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, logs, personal data or build output (`dist/`, `*.ehpk`) are included.
- [ ] New dependencies, permissions or network access are explained.
- [ ] Art and names are original (nothing from existing games or brands).
